'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2023-11-27 — 2025-07-24|ENCE}} {{TH|2025-07-24 — 2025-12-18|ENCE|Inactive}} {{TH|2025-12-19 — '''Present'''|100 Thieves|Coach}} }} Lukas "'''gla1ve'''" Rossander {{born}} is a [[:Category:Denmark|Danish]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' coach and former professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'', ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' and ''[[Counter-Strike: Source]]'' player. He is one of the most accomplished [[:Category:In-game leaders|in-game leaders]] in ''Global Offensive'', having led [[Astralis]] to four record-breaking [[Majors|Major]] victories. gla1ve was a member of the legendary [[Astralis]] lineup from 2018 to 2020, winning 19 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments as a player across his career, including four [[Majors|Major championships]] and an
